# Tangison Technologies

> Tangison Technologies builds operational intelligence systems that work where connectivity drops, data arrives late, and infrastructure is uneven.

Tangison Technologies is an operational intelligence company headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia. We build systems for environments where conventional cloud-only stacks fail: low or intermittent connectivity, late-arriving data, uneven infrastructure, and harsh physical conditions. Our methodology is built around three phases — Observe, Decide, Operate — and our products are designed to run inside the customer's own infrastructure rather than depending on third-party clouds.

This is the corporate website. It is not a product documentation site. For product documentation, see the Tangison Agent product at https://agent.tangison.com (self-hosted AI agents). For client work and digital product design, see Tangison Studio at https://studio.tangison.com.

- [Company](https://www.tangison.com/company): About Tangison Technologies, its founding context in Namibia, and the team.
- [Careers](https://www.tangison.com/careers): Engineering, design and operations roles with Tangison Technologies in Windhoek.
- [Contact](https://www.tangison.com/contact): How to reach Tangison Technologies. Use this page for partnership, sales, and general enquiries.
- [Brand](https://www.tangison.com/brand): Tangison brand guidelines, identity, and visual system.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tangison.com/privacy): What this website collects and how it handles visitor data.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.tangison.com/terms): Terms for using this website.
- [Sitemap](https://www.tangison.com/sitemap): Human-readable site map.
